evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive performing a settled instruction to discard knowledge — the speaker acts on it and expects compliance, but no permanence language reaches principle.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Operational imperative with 'all' as an intensifier — a performed declarative instructing complete removal, settled and load-bearing but not identity-level bedrock.
